setup.run: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install

services.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/ --reporter=basic

security.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/container-security.test.ts ../testing/services/rbac-security.test.ts --reporter=basic

resilience.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/network-resilience.test.ts ../testing/services/redis-cluster-failures.test.ts --reporter=basic

timelapse.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/services/timelapseEngine.test.ts ../testing/services/timelapse.test.ts --reporter=basic

integration.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/integration/ --reporter=basic

db.run: cd backend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/db/ --reporter=basic

frontend.run: cd frontend && CI=true npx vitest run ../testing/frontend/ --reporter=basic
